DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨が降ってきましたね。入口へ戻られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: It has started raining. Are you going back to the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傘を車に置いたままです。ここから駐車場へ早く戻る道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車に傘を置いた事情を伝えて駐車場への戻り道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my umbrella in the car. Please tell me a quick way back to the parking lot from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you left your umbrella in the car and ask how to get back to the parking lot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車はどちらの駐車場に止めましたか。入口の番号を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which parking lot did you park in? Do you remember the entrance number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は覚えていませんが、小さな橋を渡って園内に入りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口番号が不明なため渡った橋を目印として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not remember the number, but I entered the park by crossing a small bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Since you do not know the entrance number, use the bridge you crossed as a landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 橋の近くなら東側ですね。今いる場所から、舗装された道で戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Near the bridge would be the east side. You can return from here on a paved path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 芝生を横切るほうが近そうですが、濡れているので舗装の道を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 濡れた芝生を避け舗装路を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Cutting across the grass looks shorter, but it is wet, so I will use the paved path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid the wet grass and choose the paved path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのほうが歩きやすいですね。橋の手前で道が分かれるので、右側へ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will be easier to walk on. The path forks before the bridge, so take the right branch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 橋の手前は右ですね。駐車場に屋根のある場所があれば、そこで傘を出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分岐を復唱して駐車場の屋根付き場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Right before the bridge, then. If there is somewhere with a roof in the parking lot, I would like to take out my umbrella there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the direction at the fork and ask about a covered place in the parking lot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 屋根のある待合所は駐車場の入口脇です。道の途中にはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The covered waiting shelter is beside the parking lot entrance. There is none along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待合所まで歩いて戻り、車から傘を取ります。今日は園内の散歩をここで切り上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待合所へ戻り傘を取り散歩を切り上げると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will walk back to the shelter and get my umbrella from the car. I will end today's walk in the park here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return to the shelter, get your umbrella, and finish your walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元に気をつけて、急がずお戻りください。また晴れた日にお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your step and return without rushing. We look forward to seeing you on another sunny day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符をお求めですね。行き先と、途中で降りるご予定をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to buy a ticket. Please tell me your destination and whether you plan to get off along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 終点まで行きたいのですが、途中の駅で友人と昼食を取ります。一枚の切符でよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中の駅で改札を出て昼食を取る予定を伝え、一枚で足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to the last stop, but I will have lunch with a friend at a station along the way. Will one ticket be enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to exit the gates at an intermediate station for lunch, and ask whether one ticket is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中で改札を出られるかは切符の条件によります。こちらで行程を分けて調べますので、再び乗る時刻はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether you may exit along the way depends on the ticket conditions. We will check the itinerary in separate sections. Have you decided what time to board again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼食が長引くかもしれないので、後半の列車は決めずにおきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後半の乗車時刻を固定したくない理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Lunch might run long, so I would rather leave the train for the second part undecided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you do not want to fix the boarding time for the second part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、最初の区間だけ先に購入する方法もあります。後半は途中の駅で購入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, one option is to buy only the first section now. You can buy the second part at the intermediate station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は最初の区間だけ買います。この券売機でも買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初の区間だけ買うと決め、券売機で購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will buy only the first section today. Can I buy it from this ticket machine too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to buy only the first section and ask whether you can use the ticket machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この行き先のボタンです。支払い方法を選ぶ前に、人数の表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. This is the destination button. Before selecting a payment method, please check the number of passengers displayed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人で乗るので、二枚に変えます。大人二人の表示で合っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大人二人分に枚数を変更して表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are two of us traveling, so I will change it to two tickets. The display for two adults is correct, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change the quantity to tickets for two adults and confirm the display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合っています。発券されたら、それぞれ切符をお持ちください。領収書も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is correct. When the tickets are issued, please each take your own. Do you need a receipt too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書は要りません。途中で降りた後の切符は、その駅で買うことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書を断り、後半の切符を途中の駅で買う方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: No receipt, thank you. I will buy the tickets for after we get off at the intermediate station there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decline a receipt and say you will buy the second-part tickets at the intermediate station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。昼食のお時間も含めて、ゆとりを持ってお出かけください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please allow yourselves plenty of time, including lunch. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの封筒についてのご相談ですか。差出人と、ご不明な箇所を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the envelope you brought? Could you show me the sender and the part you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月出した申請の返事です。「添付書類が不足」とありますが、何を出せばいいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申請への返事で不足書類が分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is a reply to the application I submitted last month. It says “Missing supporting documents,” but I do not know what to submit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the reply to your application does not make clear to you which documents are missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別紙に書類名が載っているようです。封筒の中に、もう一枚紙は入っていませんでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It looks as though the document names are listed on a separate sheet. Was there another piece of paper inside the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さい紙も入っていました。提出期限が金曜日になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同封の別紙を示し、金曜日の期限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This small sheet was in it too. The submission deadline is Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the enclosed separate sheet and state the Friday deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに担当部署の名前があります。私は総合受付なので、必要書類の判断はその担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible department's name is here. I work at general reception, so I will check with that department's staff which documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜日は仕事で来られません。郵送で提出できるかも、担当の方に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事で来庁できない事情と郵送提出を相談したい意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot come on Friday because of work. I would also like to ask the staff member whether I can submit them by mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that work prevents you from coming to the office and say you want to discuss submitting by mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かしこまりました。まず担当者に取り次ぎます。受付番号があると、申請を探しやすいのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. First, I will put you in touch with the staff member. A reception number would make it easier to locate your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 申請したときの控えに、この番号があります。通知と一緒に渡せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えの受付番号を示し、通知と一緒に提示すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This number is on the copy I kept when I applied. Should I present it together with the notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the reception number on your copy and ask whether to present it with the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、両方をご提示ください。期限が到着日を指すのかも、その場で確認されるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please show both. You may also want to check there whether the deadline means the date the documents must arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、担当窓口で不足書類と郵送の可否、それから期限の意味を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当窓口で確認する三点を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will check at the responsible counter which documents are missing, whether mailing is allowed, and what the deadline means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Restate the three points you will confirm at the responsible counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者がお待ちしています。こちらの通路からお進みください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member is waiting for you. Please proceed along this corridor. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご来院でしょうか。今日はどのような症状でいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit? What symptoms have brought you in today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日から右の耳が聞こえづらくて、少し詰まった感じがします。初めて受診します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診であることと、昨日から右耳が聞こえづらい症状を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since yesterday, I have had difficulty hearing in my right ear, and it feels a little blocked. This is my first consultation here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say this is your first visit and you have had difficulty hearing in your right ear since yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。急に聞こえづらくなったことを診療担当へ伝えます。めまいや強い痛みもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. I will tell the clinical staff about the sudden difficulty hearing. Do you also have dizziness or severe pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: めまいはありません。痛みもないのですが、いつからかは昨日の夕方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: めまいと痛みがないこと、発症した時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No dizziness. There is no pain either; as for when it started, it was yesterday evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have neither dizziness nor pain, and give the onset time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過を問診票にもご記入ください。受付には、本人確認と保険の資格を確認できるものをお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write that history on the medical questionnaire too. At reception, please present something that verifies your identity and insurance eligibility.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資格を確認できるものは持っています。前に別の病院で飲んだ薬の記録も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資格確認の用意を伝え、以前の薬の記録も必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have something that verifies my eligibility. Do I also need a record of medicine I took at another hospital before?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have eligibility verification ready, and ask whether your previous medication record is needed too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちでしたら、診察のときに医師へ見せてください。薬の名前が分からなければ、分かる範囲の記入で構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have it, please show the doctor during your consultation. If you do not know the medicine names, you may fill in only what you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬の記録はスマートフォンにあります。名前を間違えたくないので、それを見ながら書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: スマートフォンの薬の記録を確認しながら記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The medication record is on my smartphone. I do not want to get the names wrong, so I will fill it in while looking at that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will fill it in while checking the medication record on your smartphone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご記入が済んだら受付へお戻りください。お呼びする声が聞き取りづらい場合はお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you finish, please return to reception. Let us know if you have trouble hearing the call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 呼び出しを聞き逃しそうなので、受付の近くで待ちます。呼ぶときに手でも合図していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付近くで待つことを伝え、手の合図での呼び出しを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I might miss the call, so I will wait near reception. Could you also signal with your hand when calling me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait near reception and ask for a hand signal when you are called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。呼び出しの際は手でも合図します。待っている間に具合が変わればお申し出ください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will also signal with a hand when calling you. If your condition changes while waiting, please tell us. Now, excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で鍵を拾いました。持ち主が困っていると思って、こちらへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵を拾ったため届けに来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found some keys on the road. I thought the owner would be having trouble, so I brought them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came to hand in keys you found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お届けいただきありがとうございます。拾った場所と、おおよその時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for bringing them in. Please tell me where and approximately when you found them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 橋を渡った先の横断歩道の手前です。十五分くらい前で、歩道の端に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 橋の先の横断歩道手前で十五分前に拾ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Before the pedestrian crossing beyond the bridge. It was about fifteen minutes ago, and they were lying at the edge of the sidewalk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found them fifteen minutes ago before the pedestrian crossing beyond the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 橋はこの地図の橋でしょうか。交差点には二つ横断歩道がありますので、どちら側か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is the bridge this one on the map? There are two pedestrian crossings at the intersection, so I would like to check which side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この橋で合っています。川に向かって左側の横断歩道です。地図では、ここになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で橋と横断歩道の側を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is the right bridge. It is the pedestrian crossing on the left when facing the river. On the map, it is here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the bridge and the side of the pedestrian crossing on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を確認できました。拾ったときに、一緒に落ちていた物はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have confirmed the location. When you found the keys, was anything else lying with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 周りには何もありませんでした。鍵についた青いタグには触らず、そのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲にほかの物がなかったことと青いタグを付いたまま届けたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was nothing around them. I did not touch the blue tag attached to the keys; I brought them in just as they were.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there were no other objects nearby and you brought the keys in with the blue tag still attached. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。拾得物として受け付けるため、お名前と連絡先などを伺います。書き方はご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. To register them as found property, I will ask for your name, contact details, and other information. I will show you how to fill it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。昼間は電話に出にくいので、連絡がつく時間も書いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先記入に同意し、電話に出られる時間も伝えたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. It is difficult for me to answer the phone during the day, so I would also like to write when I can be reached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to enter your contact details and offer to give the times you can answer the phone too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その時間もお聞きします。受け付けた内容を確認してからお帰りください。お届けありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ask about those times too. Please check the details we have accepted before leaving. Thank you for handing them in. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便についてのご相談ですね。どのようなことでお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your question is about mail. What difficulty are you having?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越してからも、古い住所に郵便が届いています。今は友人が取っておいてくれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居後も旧住所に郵便が届き友人が保管していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Even after moving, mail is still being delivered to my old address. A friend is keeping it for me now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that mail still arrives at your old address after moving and a friend is keeping it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転居に関する届出は、すでにお済みですか。お済みなら、いつお申し込みになったか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already submitted a notification of your move? If so, please tell me when you applied.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ出していません。家の契約を変えれば、郵便の住所も変わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転居届が未提出で住所変更を誤解していたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought changing my housing contract would change the address for my mail too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not filed the move notification and misunderstood how the address changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便の届出は別に必要です。こちらに手続きの案内がありますので、本人確認に必要なものも一緒にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: A separate postal notification is required. Here is the procedure guide; I will also explain what you need to verify your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私だけが引っ越して、兄は前の家に残っています。兄の郵便まで転送されませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄は旧住所に残ることを伝え兄の郵便への影響を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only I moved; my older brother remains at the former home. Will his mail be forwarded too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your older brother remains at the old address and ask how his mail will be affected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転居する方のお名前を記載していただきます。お兄様は転居しないということで、記入する方を区別しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You will enter the names of the people moving. Since your brother is not moving, let's distinguish whose name should be entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、私の名前だけ記入します。新しい住所には部屋番号まで書きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の名前だけを記載し新住所の部屋番号まで書くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will write only my name. I will include the room number in the new address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will enter only your name and write the new address including the room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。受付後すぐにすべての郵便が届くとは限りませんので、当面は旧住所の確認もお願いします。差出人への住所変更の連絡も大切です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Not all mail will necessarily arrive immediately after acceptance, so please check the old address for the time being too. It is also important to inform senders of your address change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人にはしばらく確認を頼み、請求書の差出人には自分で新しい住所を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧住所の確認を友人に頼み請求書の差出人へ新住所を伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will ask my friend to keep checking for a while and tell the senders of bills my new address myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to ask your friend to check the old address and tell the bill senders your new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それがよいと思います。ご記入が済みましたらお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I think that is a good idea. Please bring the form over once you finish filling it in. Thank you for your inquiry. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご用件をお伺いします。お口座に関するお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: How can I help? Is this a procedure concerning your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座に登録した住所を変えたいです。銀行からの通知が前の家に届かないようにしたくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知を旧住所に届けたくないため口座の住所変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to change the address registered to my account. I came because I do not want bank notices going to my former home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a change of account address so notices do not go to your old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。住所変更に必要な書類を確認します。新しい住所が確認できる本人確認書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. I will check the documents needed for an address change. Do you have an identity document showing the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 身分証明書はありますが、住所はまだ古いままです。これでは今日の手続きは難しいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 身分証の住所が古いと伝え当日手続きできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have identification, but the address is still the old one. Does that make it difficult to complete the procedure today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the address on your ID is old and ask whether the procedure can be completed today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この書類だけで受け付けられるとは申し上げられません。ほかに使える書類があるか、担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I cannot say we can accept this document alone. I will check with the person in charge whether another document can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住民票なら用意できます。必要な記載事項も確認してから取りに行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住民票を用意できると伝え必要な記載事項の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can get a resident record. I would like to confirm what details it needs to show before going to obtain it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can obtain a resident record and ask to confirm the required details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住民票を使えるかと、必要な記載事項を確認してお伝えします。ほかにお急ぎの通知はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will confirm whether a resident record can be used and which details are needed, then let you know. Are there any other urgent notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードの更新案内を待っています。すでに発送されているかも調べていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードの更新案内を待っていると伝え発送状況の調査を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am waiting for information about renewing my card. Could you also check whether it has already been sent?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are waiting for card renewal information and ask to have its mailing status checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の確認後に、調べられる範囲でお調べします。発送済みの場合の対応も別に確認しますので、住所変更が発送に間に合うとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After verifying your identity, we will check as far as we can. We will separately confirm what to do if it has already been sent, so the address change may not be in time for mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。まず必要書類を確かめて、更新案内の送付先も確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要書類と更新案内の送付先の確認を済ませたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. First I will check the necessary documents, and I will confirm where the renewal information is being sent before I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to finish checking the required documents and the destination of the renewal information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。担当者に引き継ぎますので、こちらで少々お待ちください。それでは失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will hand this over to the staff member in charge, so please wait here a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 調味料をお探しですか。こちらの棚で迷われているようでしたので。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for seasonings? You seemed unsure at this shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このたれを買いたいのですが、大豆が入っているか、どこを見れば分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: たれの大豆含有を確認する表示の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy this sauce. Where should I look to see whether it contains soybeans?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the label shows whether the sauce contains soybeans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 裏面の原材料名と、アレルゲンについての表示をご覧ください。この商品には大豆の記載があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look at the ingredients and allergen information on the back. This product lists soybeans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですか。大豆を避けたいので、これは戻します。隣の商品も一緒に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大豆を避けたいと説明し別商品の表示の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I want to avoid soybeans, so I will put this back. Could you check the neighboring product's label with me too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to avoid soybeans and ask for help checking another product's label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 隣の商品はこの欄です。文字が小さいので、明るいところで見ましょう。表示だけで判断しづらければ、メーカーへの確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: For the neighboring product, it is this section. The print is small, so let's look somewhere brighter. If the label alone is hard to interpret, you need to check with the manufacturer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これは今日は買わず、メーカーに確認します。こちらのハーブ入りの塩だけにしますが、保存方法はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明な商品を保留してメーカーへ確認すると決めハーブ入りの塩の保存表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not buy this today; I will check with the manufacturer. I will only take this herb salt, but where are the storage instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to leave the unclear product for now and ask the manufacturer, then ask where the herb salt's storage label is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保存方法は袋の下にあります。「高温多湿を避けて保存」とありますね。開封後は袋の口をしっかり閉じてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The storage instructions are at the bottom of the bag. They say to store away from heat and humidity. After opening, please close the bag tightly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 台所の流しの下は湿気が多いので、乾いた棚に置きます。賞味期限はこの印字ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 湿気の多い場所を避ける保存方針を伝え賞味期限の印字を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Under the kitchen sink is humid, so I will keep it on a dry shelf. This printed date is the best-before date, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid a humid storage location and confirm the printed best-before date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。期限の表示と保存方法は、併せて確認してください。袋に傷や穴がないかもご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, here. Please check the date label together with the storage instructions. Also check for scratches or holes in the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋は破れていません。今日はこのハーブ入りの塩を買って、たれは問い合わせてから選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋に損傷がないと伝えハーブ入りの塩のみ購入し調味料は問い合わせ後に選ぶと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The bag is not torn. I will buy this herb salt today and choose a sauce again after making an inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the bag is undamaged, decide to buy only the herb salt, and choose a seasoning after your inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お問い合わせ先は表示のこちらです。お買い物ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The contact details are here on the label. Thank you for shopping. Please come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧ですか。初めてでしたら、現在地をご説明しますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the map? If this is your first visit, I can explain where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、初めて来ました。二十分ほど歩いて、この入口に戻れる道を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初訪問で二十分程度歩いて同じ入口に戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, this is my first visit. I am looking for a route where I can walk for about twenty minutes and return to this entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say this is your first visit and you want to walk about twenty minutes and return to the same entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今いるのは南入口です。広場を一周する道なら戻れますが、途中に段差があります。段差のない道のほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are at the south entrance. A path around the plaza will bring you back, but it has steps along the way. Would you prefer a path without steps?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 靴擦れがあるので、段差の少ない道がいいです。長く歩くより、途中で座りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 靴擦れを理由に段差の少ない道と休憩を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My shoes have rubbed my skin sore, so I would prefer fewer steps. Rather than walking a long time, I would like to sit down along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your shoe chafing and ask for fewer steps and a rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、案内図のこの舗装路を進み、ベンチで折り返すのはいかがでしょう。周回せず、同じ道を戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, how about following this paved path on the map and turning around at the bench? You can return the same way without making a loop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そのベンチまで行くことにします。分かれ道ではどちらへ進めばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチで折り返すと決め分かれ道の方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will go as far as that bench. Which way should I go at the fork?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to turn back at the bench and ask which way to take at the fork. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きな木のところで右です。左へ行くと坂になります。ベンチから戻るときは、来た舗装路をたどってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Right at the large tree. Left takes you onto a slope. When returning from the bench, follow the paved path you came on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行きは大きな木で右、帰りは同じ道ですね。入口の名前を忘れそうなので、この案内図を撮っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 進路を言い直し案内図を撮ることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Right at the large tree on the way there, and the same way back. I might forget the entrance name, so I will take a picture of this map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the route and say you will photograph the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 南入口の文字も写真に入れておくと分かりやすいですよ。ベンチが混んでいたら、無理に先へ進まず戻っても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It will be clearer if you include the words “South Entrance” in the photo too. If the bench is crowded, you may turn back without forcing yourself to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南入口も写しました。座れなければ引き返して、今日は短い散歩にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 南入口を撮影したと伝え座れなければ引き返す方針を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I included the south entrance in the photo too. If I cannot sit, I will turn back and keep today's walk short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you photographed the south entrance and decide to turn back if you cannot sit down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元に気をつけてお楽しみください。お帰りも南入口を目印にしてくださいね。では、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your walk and watch your step. Use the south entrance as your landmark on the way back too. Have a good walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: スーツケースの車輪が外れたようですが、改札へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: It looks as though a wheel has come off your suitcase. Are you heading to the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。持ち上げると重いので、階段を避けたいです。この通路の先にエレベーターはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車輪故障と階段回避希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is heavy when I lift it, so I want to avoid stairs. Is there an elevator beyond this passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the broken wheel and your wish to avoid stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありますが、手前の通路は清掃中です。左の迂回表示に沿って進んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is, but the passage before it is being cleaned. Could you follow the detour signs to the left?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左へ回るんですね。途中で荷物を置いて休める所もあれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迂回方向と休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: A detour to the left, then. Please also tell me if there is somewhere along the way where I can put my luggage down and rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the detour direction and a place to rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 迂回路の壁際にベンチがあります。通路をふさがないよう、荷物は座席の横へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a bench by the wall on the detour. Please place your luggage beside the seat so it does not block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで一度休みます。エレベーターを降りた後は、広い改札を探せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩後の広い改札の利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will rest there once. After getting out of the elevator, should I look for a wide ticket gate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm using a wide ticket gate after resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札の係員に荷物のことをお伝えください。係員が通れる幅を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the gate staff about your luggage. They will check the width you can pass through and guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。自分で狭い改札に押し込まず、降りた所で係員を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 狭い改札へ無理に進まず係員を呼ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not force it into a narrow gate myself; I will call a staff member where I get out of the elevator.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not force your way through a narrow gate and will call staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車輪の外れた部分が引っかかるかもしれませんので、無理に引きずらないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The part where the wheel came off may catch on something, so please do not drag it by force.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取れた車輪は袋に入れました。休みながら運び、改札では幅を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外れた車輪の収納と段階的な移動を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the detached wheel in a bag. I will carry the suitcase with rests and have the gate staff check the width.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you stored the detached wheel and will move in stages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、左の表示からお進みください。荷物にも足元にもお気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please follow the signs on the left. Take care with your luggage and watch your step. Have a good trip.
